title: The Shannon Rose
venue_description:
The Shannon Rose — Clifton

The Shannon Rose is an Irish pub and restaurant on Kingsland Road in Clifton, part of a small regional group of Shannon Rose locations. It runs a full kitchen alongside a regular calendar of DJs and live bands, and functions as one of Clifton's steadier nightlife destinations.

Atmosphere and Setting

Expect a classic Irish-pub setting: a long bar, hearty pub food, and a friendly, unpretentious crowd. Weekends typically bring a live band or DJ set, drawing a mixed crowd of regulars and pub-goers out for a night of music.

Live Music and Open Mic

An open mic night has been listed for Wednesdays at 8:00 PM at this location. A note for readers: this listing traces back to a directory snapshot from spring 2025, and the pub's own current live-music page shows only its regular Friday and Saturday DJ and band nights without a Wednesday open mic currently listed. It is worth confirming directly with the pub — by phone or via its Instagram and Facebook pages — before planning a visit around it, in case the night has moved, paused or changed format since.

Other Events

Beyond the open mic, The Shannon Rose books regular Friday and Saturday night entertainment, ranging from DJ sets to live bands, as part of its weekend programming.

Good to Know

The Shannon Rose is located at 98 Kingsland Road, Clifton, NJ. Call ahead to confirm the open mic is still running before making a special trip.
